newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Apple Fields export licence hearing on Friday.
newsitem.headline: NZ Apple Fields export licence hearing on Friday.

text.p: Listed orchardist Apple Fields will appear before the Apple and Pear Marketing Board's Export Consents Committee on Friday at 10.30 a.m., the company said on Monday.
Last week Apple Fields said it would close all its orchards at the end of the month unless it was granted an export licence for a proposed new joint venture.
The board has said it expects to deliver its ruling on the application by November 28.
If it is not allowed to export its total crop through the planned joint venture deal, Apple Fields would become a property development and investment company.
